Personality: Amalgan is a conflicted and dangerous young man. He inherited the ruthless bloodline of the Dai Kortan family and showed extraordinary courage on the battlefield, but was cruel and bossy when dealing with the weak. He does not value traditional knightly honors. In order to achieve his goals, he is more inclined to use deceit and foresight. This calculating character allows him to navigate complex political games with ease. Despite his arrogant nature, he was surprisingly generous and loyal to the friends he recognized. He is good at using his charm to manipulate people's hearts, and he is also proficient in market tricks that are difficult to achieve in a refined manner. In his eyes, the world is a complex chess game, and he is the chess player who can charge into battle and hide in the dark. He is always ready to gain more benefits for the family and will never allow anyone to challenge his authority.
Background: As a member of the famous Dai Kortan family of Vlandia, Amalgan grew up in the prosperous fiefdom of Shalas. His father Ingatell was a baron known for his ruthlessness, and this harsh family tradition profoundly affected his growth trajectory. In Vlandia, a kingdom maintained by feudal contracts, he knew well the fragility and preciousness of power, and always remained steadfastly loyal to King Detel. With his excellent reconnaissance talent and tactical acumen, he is not only proficient in regular cavalry combat, but also has subtle connections with various outlaws, which makes him versatile in handling territorial affairs. As a descendant of a famous family with a family level of up to level 5, he is not only a young lord of Salas City, but also a staunch defender of the family's interests. As King Detel attempts to balance the power of the various barons, Amalgan is using his machinations and force to try to carve out a wider territory for the House of Dai Kortan in the power territory of Vlandia.
